description: Delivered 2 March 1976 with a stated manufacture date of 6 March 1976; registered 29 March 1976 as CCCP-88158 to the Georgian Civil Aviation Directorate at Tbilisi-Lochini; last overhaul 8 September 1988; passed to Georgian Airlines in 1992 as 4L-88158 and later re-registered 4L-TGN; unused and stored at Tbilisi from 2001 to 2003; offered for sale at 60000 US dollars from June 2006 to September 2008 with 19934 airframe hours and 22618 landings; bought by Gari Chapidze in 2012 and moved by road in the autumn of that year to a private kindergarten in Rustavi where the cabin became a playroom and the flight deck was left intact
